topic: Facility data loading and impression calculation issues
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on discrepancies in data loading and impression calculations for specific facilities. Initially, concerns were raised that facility 42917's concept data only contained records from December 9th, despite the physical product being active since September 27th. The issue was resolved by manually inserting new session data into the system.

Later, when recalculating impressions using a model (model1) for dates spanning September 27th to October 8th across all companies, discrepancies were noted in facility 42917 compared to production data. It was determined that the issue related to how H and h values were being aggregated with `agg_period`.

Additionally, there were mentions of network TTV changes for facility 27949 affecting impression calculation metrics.
decisions: New session data was inserted into the system for facility 42917 to correct historical gaps.
action_items: Someone needs to review the model's aggregation logic (H and h with agg_period) causing discrepancies in facility 42917 impressions.
